nodes.title: ServiceNow Certified System Administrator

nodes.title: Blue Prism RPA Professional Developer
nodes.description: Designing and developing Robotic Process Automation (RPA) solutions. Managing object and process layers; implementing exception handling. Linked to the Swarm Coordination track.

nodes.title: Meta Certified Spark AR Creator
nodes.description: Designing and building augmented reality (AR) effects for mobile. Mapping 4D cross-section visualization to consumer AR standards.

nodes.title: SASB Fundamentals of Sustainability Accounting (FSA)
nodes.description: The global standard for ESG reporting. Identifying and managing material sustainability information. Mapping the Mycelial Oracle and J/Φ metrics to SASB standards.

nodes.title: Certified Blockchain Professional (Blockchain Council)
nodes.description: Deep understanding of blockchain and DLT. Smart contracts, P2P networks, and cryptographic security. Mapping Holochain/Mycelix to the broader FinTech mesh.
